searchText: This one is for burn only. I m pretty sure there was website which showed after merge stats as well. https://ultrasound.money/ ? Yes, and I never try to make false problems for you. All what I share here are my legitimate thoughts not related to the fact I’m advocating for or against the merge. I’m not the one who has the “PoS will moon ETH” cap, so I’m not going to ignore legitimate issues with the Merge deployment. Just saying “AlexSSD7 hates merge let’s just ignore him” means YOLOing and following survivorship bias of people who think that PoS will make ETH go to the moon. Doing this is extremely incompetent from your side (as a core developer). YOLOing with the “Why not” approach proposed by some PoS shills is something I am definitely against of. I hold a lot of ETH, and I don’t want it to crash into oblivion. Hence I’m expressing my technical concerns.
